title: Amendment 1: Expanded Judicial Authority on Bail
plainEnglish: Adds additional violent-crime categories where judges may deny bail before trial.
yesMeans: Broader pre-trial detention authority for judges in specified cases.
whyItMatters: This can affect public safety policy, jail capacity, and due-process debates in local communities.

title: Amendment 2: District Attorney Salary Protection
plainEnglish: Prevents lowering a district attorney's salary during the elected term.
whyItMatters: This shapes independence versus accountability in prosecutorial leadership.
